title: PFRDA Regulations on NPS Annuity Purchase and Pension Income
source: Pension Fund Regulatory and Development Authority (PFRDA)
content: PFRDA regulations require NPS subscribers exiting at superannuation (age 60) to utilize at least 40% of their accumulated pension corpus to purchase an annuity from an empanelled Annuity Service Provider (ASP). Annuity options include Life Annuity with Return of Premium, Joint Life Annuity, or Increasing Annuity, providing regular monthly pension income throughout post-retirement life.
